adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the booking attendees are persisted via `prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...)` before side effects (`eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` and `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)`). There is no transaction/rollback around the DB write, and `updateCalendarAttendees` is not guarded; if it throws, the mutation fails after the DB change, leaving the DB updated but the calendar not updated. Email sending is also best-effort (caught/logged), so DB/calendar state can diverge from invite notifications.
